_comment: THE LIVE PARTNER SHOP LIST. Edit this file, push, done.
Adding a shop does NOT need an App Store build. Every push to feature-work
redeploys mrtapioca.me in about a minute, and every copy of the app (web
AND the installed iPhone app) picks this up the next time the Boba Map is
opened. Removing a shop is the same edit in reverse, which is how we keep
the promise made in the pitch: it comes off the app the day they ask.
Fields, per shop:
id          stable slug, never reused for a different shop
name        as the student will read it on the map
address     shown on the counter card
lat, lng    the storefront
perk        EXACTLY what that shop agreed to, in words a barista can honour
minMinutes  CUMULATIVE focus time that unlocks it, added up across any
number of sittings, not one long session (minimum 15)
since       the day they said yes
Never invent a perk or a number. A shop goes in here only after it has
agreed in writing. Anything malformed is dropped by the app rather than
guessed at, and a minMinutes under 15 is rejected outright.
REWARD POLICY (added 2026-08-13, matches what the shops were told).
A student studies 4 CUMULATIVE hours and can then redeem at their shop.
One shared bar, so a reward earned anywhere is spendable at any partner.
That is what 'global_passport' means, and it mirrors the live server row
in public.reward_policies. If you change one, change the other.
Every shop must carry a policyId. A shop with none, or one whose
minMinutes disagrees with its policy's requiredMinutes, is rejected
rather than guessed at.
